entities.name: Aevar Borg
entities.description: Terisian guide during the Thaw of Dominaria.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: Led by Aevar Borg to Ronom Glacier.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: Glacier where the last Phyrexian War Beast was frozen.

entities.name: Phyrexian War Beast
entities.description: Giant beast frozen in Ronom Glacier, destroyed by a bomb.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: Figure whose clutches the War Beast was kept from.

entities.name: Battle of Kjeldor
entities.description: Battle shortly after which the War Beast was found.

events.summary: Aevar Borg leads Arcum Dagsson to Ronom Glacier and uncovers the last Phyrexian War Beast frozen inside.
events.quote: led Arcum Dagsson to Ronom Glacier and uncovered the last of the Phyrexian War Beasts frozen inside

events.summary: After accidentally waking the beast, they activate a bomb that blows it apart, keeping it from Heidar.
events.quote: they succeeded in activating a powerful bomb that blew the creature apart

relations.note: He guided Arcum to the glacier.
relations.quote: Aevar Borg led Arcum Dagsson to Ronom Glacier
